recognize_zh: 沿抹片邊緣排成一列的單核細胞，核圓到橢圓、染色質細緻，淡藍灰胞質邊緣不規則並有細絲狀突起，其中一顆為較大的雙葉或凹陷核；左下另有嗜中性球作對照。
features: Row of medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular, frayed hair-like margins
One larger cell with an indented/bilobed nucleus
Segmented neutrophils and a granulated myeloid cell at lower left for comparison
Cells aligned along a smear edge, where cytoplasmic fraying can be accentuated
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of medium-sized mononuclear cells aligned along the edge of the smear, with round to oval or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, fine hair-like projections. Segmented neutrophils and a granulated myeloid cell are present nearby. Because the cells lie at a smear edge where cytoplasmic fraying is common, projections should be confirmed in a well-spread area. Findings are consistent with hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, and are CD14 positive rather than CD103/CD25 positive.
SMZL cells have short polar villi and clumped chromatin and lack the HCL immunophenotype and BRAF V600E.
HCL-v cells have prominent nucleoli and lack CD25 and annexin A1.
